thread:
Maya: dropped two new variants for onboarding UX: 'compact rail' (sticky at bottom) and 'guided overlay' (center modal). want quick reactions: usability, accessibility, and implementation risk.
Ethan: compact rail looks less interruptive. users can keep working while the rail guides them. overlay is clearer for people who want a step-by-step. unsure about mobile behavior for rail.
Priya: UX note 12: rail should show a tiny progress indicator and the next-action label (e.g., 'Add your first key'). overlay should support keyboard nav and announce the step via aria-live.
Rory: eng estimation: rail = single sticky component + a small API to fetch next step  ~ 6-8 hrs. overlay = modal manager, focus trap, portal, animations  ~ 2 days. overlay also needs prefers-reduced-motion handling.
Maya: copy suggestions:
- rail primary CTA: "Start with a sample project"
- rail secondary link: "See templates"
- overlay header: "Set up in 3 mins"
- skip copy: "Skip setup" (low contrast but keyboard visible)
Ethan: accessibility nit: the current rail mock uses a 12px body font and 30% contrast for secondary links. bump to 14px and ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text. Also visible focus for all buttons.
Priya: analytics: track onboarding_shown, onboarding_cta_click (props: variant, step), onboarding_skipped, sample_selected. Also capture device type (desktop/mobile) to measure rail vs overlay performance.
Maya: product preference: prefer rail to reduce dropoff, but keep overlay as fallback for users who opt into guided flow. Need AB test plan.
Rory: can we toggle via a feature flag? I'll add a runtime flag per org. deploy-bot: feature flag created: onboarding.ui_variant (default=rail).
Maya: action items: Ethan finalize a11y token list, Rory add feature flag + server-side toggle, Priya add events and a quick dashboard card. I'll draft AB test metrics: completion rate, time-to-first-call, and support tickets.
Ethan: quick implementation checklist for rail:
- sticky container + responsive collapse on small screens
- focusable CTAs with 2px outline on focus-visible
- color updates for contrast
- aria-live region for step announcements
Rory: staging plan: roll rail to 10% orgs behind flag, run automated axe checks, manual screenreader pass. Estimated rollout: 1 week after PR.
Maya: thanks all. I'll update the spec and include copy variants. Meeting to review staging QA Friday 11am. :emoji_tada:
